title: ReconcileStatementPayload
description: Payload for the RECONCILE_STATEMENT intent. Reports the result of matching external statement lines (bank, card, processor) against recorded transactions for a given period.

business_id.description: Business unit / cost center the statement belongs to.

matched_count.description: Number of statement lines that matched a recorded transaction.

unmatched_count.description: Number of statement lines that could not be matched. Triggers AUDIT_REVIEW_REQUEST when > 0.

discrepancy_total.description: Absolute total amount across all unmatched or mismatched lines. >$500 escalates per Finance prompt.

reconciled_by.description: Agent that ran the reconciliation. Almost always agent_finance.

unmatched_items.description: Detail on unmatched lines, for downstream investigation. Required when unmatched_count > 0.

candidate_transaction_ids.description: Possible matching transactions that didn't quite line up.

statement_total_credit.description: Sum of all credit (inflow) lines on the statement. Optional reference figure.

statement_total_debit.description: Sum of all debit (outflow) lines on the statement. Optional reference figure.

allOf.description: When unmatched_count > 0, unmatched_items must be provided so investigation has data to work with.
